column2: A curved single-edged sabre of polished silver steel, strongly curved like a crescent moon, silver crossguard with two small crescent moon tips, white leather grip, silver pommel with a round moonstone. A single one-handed sword, full length, no scabbard, no stand.

A straight one-handed longsword: slender pale blue steel blade engraved with moon phases along a central fuller, ending in a sharp point; silver crossguard of two swept feathers; dark blue leather grip; silver pommel with a pale blue gem. A single sword, full length, no scabbard, no stand.

A single medieval Georgian steel pauldron for the left shoulder: three overlapping curved lames joined with bronze rivets, rolled edge, engraved border. The armor piece alone, no body, no mannequin, no stand.

A single fantasy silver pauldron for the left shoulder made of layered crescent-moon shaped plates engraved with feathers, smooth polished silver. The armor piece alone, no body, no mannequin, no stand.

A single fantasy pauldron for the left shoulder of blackened steel with jagged layered plates, glowing orange ember cracks and two short curved spikes. The armor piece alone, no body, no mannequin, no stand.
A Georgian queen's gold diadem: a narrow gold circlet band with a raised front piece bearing a Bolnisi cross set with red garnets. The jewelry alone, no head, no mannequin, no stand.
A slender silver circlet with a crescent moon at the front holding a pale moonstone, a fine filigree band. The jewelry alone, no head, no mannequin, no stand.
A fantasy gold crown of rising flames: a circlet band with tall flame-shaped spikes of gold and red enamel and a ruby at the front. The jewelry alone, no head, no mannequin, no stand.
